hunks.baseline: Toward the Black Dragon’s eye—larger than Jin’s entire body, and darker than anything else in existence.
hunks.sol: Toward the Black Dragon’s eye—larger than Jin’s entire body, and blacker than anything else.

hunks.baseline: No—the countless threads hidden within that space.
hunks.sol: No—the countless seams hidden within it.

hunks.baseline: But at last, the two beings facing each other knew.
hunks.sol: But the two beings who had finally come face-to-face knew.

hunks.baseline: That single strike had instantly shattered the highest-grade defensive magic, layered dozens of times over.
hunks.sol: That single strike had cut through dozens of layers of the highest-grade defensive magic at once.

hunks.baseline: The flow of qi, which had become clearer to him as his insight deepened and his martial prowess grew, was there in the monster before him, too.
hunks.sol: As his insight deepened and his martial prowess grew, he had begun to sense the flow of qi more and more clearly. Now he could sense it in the monster before him, too.

hunks.baseline: An immense force suddenly dropped from above.
hunks.sol: An immense force suddenly fell on him from above.

hunks.baseline: “Did you think I wouldn’t see even this coming?”
hunks.sol: “Did you think I wouldn’t anticipate even this?”

hunks.baseline: The thick dust cloud burst apart. Jin Taekyung raced over the ground, sliced through like tofu, dodging the onslaught as Morgoth unleashed one spell after another.
hunks.sol: The thick dust cloud burst apart. Jin Taekyung raced over ground sliced through like tofu, dodging as Morgoth unleashed one spell after another.

hunks.baseline: His voice continued, almost as if he were talking to himself.
hunks.sol: Morgoth’s voice continued, almost as if he were talking to himself.

hunks.baseline: Until now, fear had seemed to the great being Morgoth nothing more than a weakness.
hunks.sol: Until now, fear had seemed to a great being like Morgoth nothing more than a weak emotion.

hunks.baseline: But today, by watching a certain human, he had glimpsed a great truth he had been ignoring.
hunks.sol: But today, watching one human, he had glimpsed a great truth he had been refusing to face.

hunks.baseline: Like the person fighting his way through a curtain of magic that now surrounded him on all sides, closing in without a gap, relying on nothing but a single spear.
hunks.sol: Like the person fighting his way through a curtain of magic that surrounded him on all sides, closing in without a gap, relying on nothing but a single spear.

hunks.baseline: Morgoth let go of the barest courtesy he had used not for his opponent, but to maintain his own dignity. He let go of the last sliver of arrogance that remained. Then he added quietly:
hunks.sol: Morgoth dropped the barest courtesy he had maintained for the sake of his own dignity, not his opponent’s. He let go of the last sliver of arrogance that remained. Then he added quietly:

hunks.baseline: “Because I’m… afraid of you, you bastard.”
hunks.sol: “Because I’m… afraid of you.”

hunks.baseline: The ground caved in within a hundred meters of Jin Taekyung. Countless thorny vines burst through the cracks and surged toward their target.
hunks.sol: The ground caved in within a radius of a hundred meters around Jin Taekyung. Countless thorny vines burst through the cracks and surged toward him.

hunks.baseline: A sharp whistle rang out from every direction.
hunks.sol: Sharp whistles rang out from every direction.

hunks.baseline: Their trunks were as thick as mature trees, covered without a gap by enormous thorns.
hunks.sol: Their stems were as thick as the trunks of mature trees, covered from end to end in enormous thorns.

hunks.baseline: Instead of sunlight, they had drunk their fill of the Black Dragon’s magical power. Each one was strong enough to crush a human body in an instant, and Jin Taekyung could feel the power within them.
hunks.sol: They had drunk their fill of the Black Dragon’s magical power instead of sunlight. Each one was strong enough to crush a human body in an instant, and Jin Taekyung could feel the power within them.

hunks.baseline: *Grit.*

He planted a step with the weight of a thousand pounds, using that foot as his pivot, he gathered the internal energy he had left—not even half of what he’d started with—and poured it into the tip of White Flame.
hunks.sol: He stepped forward, planting a foot with the weight of a thousand pounds. Using it as his pivot, he gathered the internal energy he had left—not even half of what he’d started with—and poured it into the tip of White Flame.

hunks.baseline: In the life-or-death crisis, the first form of the Blazing Flame Divine Spear, at last approaching the pinnacle of its realm, flowed along the spearhead.
hunks.sol: In the midst of a life-or-death struggle, the first form of the Blazing Flame Divine Spear, at last reaching the edge of its realm, flowed along the spearhead.

hunks.baseline: The fiery storm crossed a single line, then spread into a vast circle, hungrily devouring everything in its path.
hunks.sol: The fiery storm spread beyond a single line into a vast circle, hungrily devouring everything in its path.

hunks.baseline: Ash-white powder and still-glowing embers drifted like snow.
They swept past Jin Taekyung, standing alone and upright in the heat haze rising from the ground.
hunks.sol: White ash and still-glowing embers drifted like snow past Jin Taekyung, who stood alone in the heat haze rising from the ground.

hunks.baseline: A force far beyond the bounds of ordinary gravity magic shook the sky. Magic spells of devastating power filled the gaps, each one as powerful as the dazzling flashes they produced.
hunks.sol: A force far beyond ordinary gravity magic shook the sky. Powerful attack spells filled the gaps, their flashes dazzling.

hunks.baseline: All in one direction, for one purpose.
hunks.sol: All directed toward one place, for one purpose.

hunks.baseline: First, his knees buckled under the weight of dozens of tons of gravity. Thick thorny vines, slithering like living snakes, bound his whole body.
hunks.sol: His knees buckled first under a weight of dozens of tons. Thick thorny vines slithered over him like living snakes and bound his whole body.

hunks.baseline: At the same time, dozens of spells converged in the air, shining on one human like a small sun.
hunks.sol: At the same time, dozens of spells converged in the air, shining down on one human like a small sun.

hunks.baseline: Or if Jin Taekyung had possessed a Dragonheart, brimming with power almost without limit like his own, perhaps Jin Taekyung would be the one standing there now instead of him.
hunks.sol: Or if Jin Taekyung had possessed a Dragonheart, brimming with power almost without limit like his own, perhaps Jin Taekyung would have been the one left standing instead.

hunks.baseline: The size of the vessel that could contain their power, the total amount of strength they possessed—it was different.
hunks.sol: The size of the vessel that could contain their power, the total amount of strength they possessed—those were different.

hunks.baseline: The two beings were different in every way, and each had fought the other with everything they had. But the vessel of power within Morgoth was deeper and larger than Jin Taekyung’s.
hunks.sol: The two beings were different in every way, and each had fought the other with everything they had. But Morgoth’s vessel of power was deeper and larger than Jin Taekyung’s.

hunks.baseline: That was the sole reason that decided the battle today—and, beyond that, the fate of this world.
hunks.sol: That was the sole reason this battle—and, beyond it, the fate of the world—had been decided.

hunks.baseline: No matter how much he emptied and poured out, pure magical power continued to fill him without end. Its chillingly low rumble swirled between the Dragon’s teeth, dark as a cave.
hunks.sol: No matter how much power he poured out, pure magical power continued to fill him without end. It swirled between the Dragon’s teeth, dark as a cave, with a chillingly low rumble.

hunks.baseline: The range and destructive power were far below their usual level, partly because he feared harming the Dragon-tooth soldiers, and partly because he had so little time left to use it.
hunks.sol: Because he feared harming the Dragon-tooth soldiers, and because he had so little time to release it, its range and destructive power fell far short of their usual level.

hunks.baseline: *Jin Taekyung. The weakest of humans, and yet a hero stronger than anyone.*
hunks.sol: *Jin Taekyung. The weakest of humans, and yet a hero more resilient than anyone.*

hunks.baseline: At the same time, the immense magical power flowing from the Dragonheart—the purest, deepest darkness—finally became a single flash and shot forward.
hunks.sol: At the same time, the immense magical power flowing from the Dragonheart—the purest, deepest darkness—became a single flash and shot forward.

hunks.baseline: But his dimming eyes weren’t fixed on the countless spells coloring the air, or the Dragon’s breath, which held more power than all of them combined.
hunks.sol: But his eyes, dimmer than usual, weren’t fixed on the countless spells coloring the air, or the Dragon’s breath, which held more power than all of them combined.

hunks.baseline: He had been captured by a sensation that ruled his body and flesh.
hunks.sol: He had been caught in a sensation that ruled his body and flesh.

hunks.baseline: True to the meaning contained in those two characters, Jin Taekyung forgot everything.
hunks.sol: True to the meaning of those two characters, Jin Taekyung forgot everything.

hunks.baseline: In a sensation he hadn’t experienced once since that day, Jin Taekyung lifted his spear as if entranced.
hunks.sol: Feeling something he hadn’t experienced since that day, Jin Taekyung lifted his spear as if entranced.
